record.one_liner: Bright Data provides proxy and web data collection infrastructure with API access via API keys and native proxy protocol authentication.

auth_methods.quote: Authenticate with Bright Data using 1 of 2 methods: API Access with an API key or Native Access with proxy username and password.

official_mcp.quote: Agent API keys authenticate the Bright Data MCP server and AI agents.

auth_methods.reason: The page states Bright Data uses API Access with an API key and Native Access with proxy username and password, but does not explicitly mention HTTP basic authentication.
